# wallix.bastion.passwordchangepolicy

Manage password change policies on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.1.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete a credential change policy on a WALLIX Bastion.
- A password change policy says how the Bastion generates new passwords and SSH keys for the accounts it manages, and when it changes them.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_passwordchangepolicy` Terraform resource.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-change-period"></a>**change_period** | `str` | When the credentials are changed, as a cron expression, for example `0 3 * * 1`.<br>`""` disables the scheduled change. |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-description"></a>**description** | `str` | Description of the policy. |
| <a id="parameter-digit-chars"></a>**digit_chars** | `int` | Minimum number of digits in the generated passwords.<br>`0` allows them without a minimum. A character class never set is not used at all. |
| <a id="parameter-exclude-chars"></a>**exclude_chars** | `str` | Characters never used in the generated passwords, for example `Il0O`. |
| <a id="parameter-lower-chars"></a>**lower_chars** | `int` | Minimum number of lower case letters in the generated passwords.<br>`0` allows them without a minimum. A character class never set is not used at all. |
| <a id="parameter-password-change-policy-name"></a>**password_change_policy_name** | `str` / required | Name of the policy. Identifies the policy on the Bastion. |
| <a id="parameter-password-length"></a>**password_length** | `int` | Length of the generated passwords.<br>The Bastion requires at least password or SSH key settings when it creates a policy, and at least one of [`special_chars`](#parameter-special-chars), [`lower_chars`](#parameter-lower-chars), [`upper_chars`](#parameter-upper-chars) or [`digit_chars`](#parameter-digit-chars) with a password length. |
| <a id="parameter-special-chars"></a>**special_chars** | `int` | Minimum number of special characters in the generated passwords.<br>`0` allows them without a minimum. A character class never set is not used at all. |
| <a id="parameter-ssh-key-size"></a>**ssh_key_size** | `int` | Size of the generated SSH keys, in bits, for example `4096` for RSA or `384` for ECDSA. |
| <a id="parameter-ssh-key-type"></a>**ssh_key_type** | `str` | Type of the generated SSH keys.<br>The Bastion requires [`ssh_key_size`](#parameter-ssh-key-size) with it when it creates a policy.<br><br>Choices: `RSA`, `DSA`, `ECDSA`, `ED25519` |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the policy should exist.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-upper-chars"></a>**upper_chars** | `int` | Minimum number of upper case letters in the generated passwords.<br>`0` allows them without a minimum. A character class never set is not used at all. |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- Options left unset keep their current value on the Bastion.
- The policy is looked up by [`password_change_policy_name`](#parameter-password-change-policy-name), so it cannot be renamed with this module.
- Once a character class or the SSH key type is set, this module cannot unset it again (the API needs `null` for that); recreate the policy instead.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Change passwords and SSH keys every Monday at 3:00
  wallix.bastion.passwordchangepolicy:
    password_change_policy_name: weekly
    description: Weekly credential rotation
    password_length: 20
    lower_chars: 2
    upper_chars: 2
    digit_chars: 2
    special_chars: 0
    exclude_chars: Il0O
    ssh_key_type: ED25519
    ssh_key_size: 256
    change_period: "0 3 * * 1"

- name: Stop the scheduled change
  wallix.bastion.passwordchangepolicy:
    password_change_policy_name: weekly
    change_period: ""

- name: Remove a password change policy
  wallix.bastion.passwordchangepolicy:
    password_change_policy_name: weekly
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that differed from the Bastion and were updated.<br><br>Returned: when the policy already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["change_period"]` |
| <a id="return-passwordchangepolicy"></a>**passwordchangepolicy** | `dict` | The password change policy as returned by the Bastion API after the change. Character classes the policy does not use are `null`.<br>In check mode, the expected policy. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-passwordchangepolicy) |

<a id="sample-passwordchangepolicy"></a>

### Sample of `passwordchangepolicy`

```yaml
change_period: 0 3 * * 1
description: Weekly credential rotation
digit_chars: 2
exclude_chars: Il0O
id: 1a0f7687e96f0040005056b66c8b
lower_chars: 2
password_change_policy_name: weekly
password_length: 20
special_chars: 0
ssh_key_size: 256
ssh_key_type: ED25519
upper_chars: 2
url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/passwordchangepolicies/1a0f7687e96f0040005056b66c8b
```
